A simple guide to keeping the videos you love.
Open Browse. Search or enter a website address. You can also share a video link from another app.
Play a video, then tap Find videos. Choose a detected file, or paste a direct HTTPS video link.
Choose a file name, confirm your permission to save the video, and tap Download. Android continues the download in the background.
Open Downloads to check progress. Play or share completed videos. Retry failed downloads with a fresh link when needed.
A few thoughtful controls for your everyday browsing.
Private DNS encrypts DNS queries. It does not hide your IP address or create a VPN tunnel. Android requires you to change this setting manually.
Select Private DNS provider hostname, paste dns.adguard-dns.com, and save. To disconnect, select Automatic or Off in the same system setting.
Translations are included offline. Unlisted device languages use English. Machine translations may need regional review.
New downloads wait until Wi-Fi is available.

Delete cookies, browser cache, history, and website storage?
No ads, analytics, or developer accounts. Websites, search engines, DNS providers, and download servers receive the requests you make. Download history and bookmarks stay on this device.
Save only videos you own or are permitted to download. Respect copyright and website terms. This app cannot bypass DRM, paywalls, or platform download restrictions.
